title: COMBINED EFFECTS OF QUERCETIN AND RESVERATROL ON SUPEROXIDE ANION RADICAL PRODUCTION IN THE RAT HEART UNDER SURGICAL TRAUMA FOLLOWING SINGLE PROLONGED STRESS
venue: Актуальні проблеми сучасної медицини: Вісник Української медичної стоматологічної академії
abstract: Post-traumatic stress disorder is a highly prevalent and severe psychoneuroendocrine condition characterized by the development of a systemic inflammatory response and persistent oxidative imbalance, both of which substantially contribute to cardiovascular complications. The combination of psychological stress with surgical injury markedly amplifies the generation of reactive oxygen species, particularly the superoxide anion radical (O₂⁻•), thereby exacerbating myocardial damage. Our previous studies demonstrated a synergistic enhancement of pro-oxidant processes in the heart under the combined influence of single prolonged stress, a validated model of post-traumatic stress-like stress in rodents, and laparotomy. Of particular interest are polyphenols, which have been shown to modulate redox-sensitive signaling pathways and suppress excessive radical formation. The objective of this study was to evaluate the efficacy of quercetin and resveratrol in correcting O₂⁻• generation in the myocardium of rats subjected to surgical trauma following single prolonged stress. The experiments were performed on 28 male Wistar rats, assessing O₂⁻• production by NADPH-dependent microsomal electron transport chains, the mitochondrial respiratory chain, and leukocyte NADPH oxidase. It was established that surgical trauma on the background of single prolonged stress resulted in a pronounced increase in O₂⁻• formation from all examined sources, confirming the development of marked oxidative stress. Administration of a water-soluble quercetin formulation significantly reduced O₂⁻• production and almost completely normalized the activity of microsomal and partially mitochondrial redox systems. Resveratrol also exerted a significant, though comparatively less potent, antioxidant effect. These findings indicate that quercetin and resveratrol effectively attenuate excessive radical generation in the myocardium under combined psychoemotional and surgical stress. The observed cardioprotective effects justify further investigation of polyphenols as potential agents for pathogenetically targeted correction of cardiovascular complications associated with post-traumatic stress disorder.
